title: Sign out
description: Signing out keeps your settings and recent channels on this Roku. You can still watch public streams.

title: Video quality
description: The quality a stream starts at. You can change it while watching with the Quality button.

title: Lower live latency
description: Try to stay closer to the live broadcast. May cause more buffering on some devices or connections. Takes effect when opening a stream.

title: Show chat when a stream starts
description: Opens live chat beside the video. You can show or hide chat while watching. Chat is available for live streams.

title: Chat text size
description: Size of chat messages. Emotes and badges scale with it.

title: BetterTTV emotes
description: Show BetterTTV emotes in live chat.

title: FrankerFaceZ emotes
description: Show FrankerFaceZ emotes in live chat.

title: Browse: live channel order
description: How live channels are ordered on the Browse page.

title: Following: offline channel order
description: How offline channels you follow are ordered on the Following page.

title: Demux service URL (optional)
description: Some Twitch streams package audio and video together in a way Roku can't play directly. If you run Stitch's optional demux service on your network, enter its address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8080. Leave empty to turn it off.

title: Optional diagnostics
description: Share app usage and device details to help improve Stitch. Off by default. Changes take effect on next app start.

title: Support Stitch
description: Stitch is a free, community-built Twitch client. If it's useful to you, scan the QR code to support development on Buy Me a Coffee. Thank you!
